description: DisruptionMatrix intelligence agent configuration. Defines regions, agent types, agent instances, data sources, and output contracts. All airline names and codes are fictional.

subRegions.name: Western Europe
subRegions.overflightNote: French UIR critical for LHR routings - no French destination needed for exposure

subRegions.name: Overflight Corridor
subRegions.note: Invisible exposure corridor - westbound long-haul overflights

agentTypes.mission: Detect developing meteorological hazards (storms, fog, monsoon, cyclones, snow, low visibility) that reduce airport capacity or close airspace.

factorMapping.probability: Model agreement (ECMWF/GFS spread), number of met services converging
factorMapping.severity: Gust speeds vs. crosswind limits, visibility vs. CAT minima, rainfall intensity
factorMapping.geographicReach: Wind field / fog extent radius, airports within bbox
factorMapping.escalationRate: Score delta across last 3 model cycles
factorMapping.sourceCredibility: Tier rating of met services corroborating

agentTypes.mission: Detect ATFM regulations, sector overloads, flow restrictions, and capacity reductions that will delay flights.

factorMapping.severity: Delay minutes published, sector capacity reduction %
factorMapping.geographicReach: Number of FIRs / airports in regulation scope
factorMapping.escalationRate: Trend in delay minutes over recent cycles
factorMapping.predictionConfidence: High for published; lower for predicted overload

agentTypes.mission: Detect strike ballots, go-slow notices, union action announcements, and ground handler industrial action that reduce airport throughput or crew availability.

factorMapping.probability: Ballot result vs. announced action date
factorMapping.severity: % of workforce affected, airport closure vs. reduced rate
factorMapping.predictionConfidence: High if action date announced; medium if ballot pending

agentTypes.mission: Detect airspace restrictions, security NOTAMs, border closures, and overflight corridor changes that affect route access.

factorMapping.probability: NOTAM published vs. draft; advisory vs. mandatory
factorMapping.severity: Corridor closure vs. narrowing; reroute distance added
factorMapping.predictionConfidence: High for published NOTAMs; lower for anticipated closures

agentTypes.mission: Detect airport infrastructure failures (fuel supply, runway, ILS, power, ground systems, baggage, terminal) that reduce throughput.

factorMapping.severity: Capacity reduction % (fuel halved, runway closed, etc.)
factorMapping.timeToImpact: Immediate for active failures; scheduled for maintenance

agentTypes.mission: Detect regulatory directives (fog directives, ETOPS changes, ops spec changes, curfew changes) that alter operating rules.
Detect flight schedule disruptions — cancellations, mass delays, diversions, ground stops — from live flight tracking data (OpenSky ADS-B, AviationStack schedules) and FAA ground-stop programs.
Corroborate flight disruptions with passenger and crew social reports from aviation forums and news. Social signals enrich existing events with early-warning evidence rather than creating new events.

Event-driven agent that receives scored events, pulls published flight schedules for affected airports, and computes per-airport and per-airline operational exposure (the OPS object). Uses public schedule data only — does not access confidential airline operational data.

triggers.condition: EDPS delta >= 5 or geo/time window changed

triggers.action: recompute OPS + flag for airline solver re-intersection

triggers.condition: published schedule changes for airport with active event

dataSources.name: OAG / airline published timetables
dataSources.provides: scheduled flights per airport per day (flight no, origin, dest, dep/arr times, aircraft type, airline)

dataSources.name: Flight tracking APIs (FlightAware, Flightradar24)
dataSources.provides: real-time scheduled vs. actual times, cancellations, diversions

dataSources.name: Airport slot coordinator data
dataSources.provides: slot allocations per airline per airport

dataSources.name: Airline registry (internal config)
dataSources.provides: airline metadata: hub, secondary hub, fleet, daily departures, network share per airport, bank structure, fleet capabilities

dataSources.name: IATA/ICAO airport directory
dataSources.provides: airport coordinates, runway capabilities (CAT IIIB status), capacity

dataSources.name: Seasonal schedule (SSIM)
dataSources.provides: seasonal schedule variations, bank structure patterns

exposureModel.airlineExposureFormula: airlineExposure = edps * (0.35 * hubFactor + 0.25 * movementShareFactor + 0.20 * fleetCapabilityFactor + 0.10 * bankOverlapFactor + 0.10 * overflightFactor)

factors.name: hubFactor
factors.description: 1.5 if affected airport is airline primary hub; 1.2 if secondary hub; 0.8 if focus city; 0.5 if outstation

factors.name: movementShareFactor
factors.description: Normalized airline movement share at affected airport (netShare / 100 * 1.2, capped at 1.2)

factors.name: fleetCapabilityFactor
factors.description: 1.3 if airline fleet lacks capability for hazard (e.g. no CAT IIIB for fog); 1.0 if neutral; 0.5 if specifically equipped

factors.name: bankOverlapFactor
factors.description: 1.2 if event window overlaps airline most sensitive bank; 1.0 if any bank; 0.5 if off-peak

factors.name: overflightFactor
factors.description: 1.3 if airline overflies affected airspace with no destination there (invisible exposure); 1.0 if serves affected airport; 0.5 if no route overlap

outputContract.description: Each agent emits signals matching this schema. The Correlation & Scoring Engine consumes these and produces EVENTS[] entities.

fields.agentType: string - one of: weather, atc, industrial, geopolitical, infrastructure, regulatory
fields.detected: ISO 8601 timestamp - when the signal was detected
fields.name: string - human-readable event name
fields.airports: string[] - IATA codes of affected airports
fields.domains: string[] - affected operational domains (subset of the 9 domains)
fields.rawRefs: string[] - references to raw source data for audit

impactOutputContract.description: The ImpactAssessmentAgent produces OPS[eventId] objects matching this schema. These attach to EVENTS[] and provide per-airport and per-airline operational exposure.

fields.computedAt: ISO 8601 timestamp - when OPS was computed

airports.name: string - airport name
airports.movements: number - scheduled arrivals + departures in time window

airlines.name: string - airline name
airlines.hub: string - airline primary hub IATA code
airlines.netShare: number - airline movement share at affected airport (%)
airlines.airports: string - affected airports where airline operates (joined with ' . ')

fields.airlineScores: object - preliminary per-airline exposure scores keyed by airline key (namma, eva, ica)

sourceTiers.examples: Met service, ATC authority, airport operator, regulator

pipeline.name: Collection
pipeline.description: Agents poll their data sources at configured intervals

pipeline.name: Correlation
pipeline.description: Dedup (geo+time+category), merge corroborating sources, group signals into candidate events

pipeline.name: Scoring (EDPS)
pipeline.description: EDPS = sum(factor.val * factor.weight) for 8 factors; derive conf, traj, tti, esc

pipeline.name: Domain Impact
pipeline.description: Compute 9-domain vector (0-100 per domain) from agent domain tags + category heuristics

pipeline.name: Causal Chain
pipeline.description: Expand preliminaryEffects into 1st/2nd/3rd order chain with likelihood + lead time

pipeline.name: Evidence Assembly
pipeline.description: Attach evidence[] trail with tier + role; assign ref (DM-YYYY-NNNN)

pipeline.name: Impact Assessment
pipeline.description: ImpactAssessmentAgent pulls published schedules for affected airports, computes per-airport + per-airline exposure (OPS[eventId])

pipeline.name: Event Store
pipeline.description: Publish to EVENTS[] + OPS[] (time-series); trigger airline solver intersection
